quotes.speaker: Kasparas Jakučionis
quotes.summary_phrase: Kasparas Jakučionis on the excitement of starting the NBA season
quotes.excerpt: I think everybody excited to start the season is always I think one of the best parts
quotes.quote: It's been good. I think everybody excited to start the season is always I think one of the best parts, because you've been working all summer but you never got to really play games. So even if it's like a friendly game, exhibition game, it's still nice to be back on the court for sure.
quotes.social_post: Kasparas Jakučionis is ready to get the season underway after a long summer of training. He says the best part of this time of year is finally getting back on the court for game action.

quotes.speaker: Kasparas Jakučionis
quotes.summary_phrase: Kasparas Jakučionis on his physical health and preparation
quotes.excerpt: I feel great, I feel healthy, so I'm just trying to work on my game
quotes.quote: I feel great. I feel healthy, so I'm just trying to work on my game, work for the team and try to do the best I can.
quotes.social_post: Kasparas Jakučionis says he feels great and healthy as he prepares for the upcoming season with the Bucks.

quotes.speaker: Kasparas Jakučionis
quotes.summary_phrase: Kasparas Jakučionis on the competitive nature of team practices
quotes.excerpt: I think it's like in both teams that I've been so far, it's been really competitive
quotes.quote: I think it's like in both teams that I've been so far, it's been really competitive, and that's what I really like. We fight every game, we're diving on the balls, going for rebounds, and just fighting between each other. I think that makes you better, that makes the team better, and I think that's the key. The key towards winning is to just compete and give all-out effort even in practices.
quotes.social_post: Kasparas Jakučionis is praising the intensity of Bucks practices. He says the key to winning is to compete and give all out effort even in practice, noting that the team is diving for balls and fighting for rebounds.

quotes.speaker: Kasparas Jakučionis
quotes.summary_phrase: Kasparas Jakučionis on the importance of adaptability in basketball
quotes.excerpt: The game of basketball is really about adaptation in real time
quotes.quote: I really like it. You never know what's going to happen in the game, so you kind of have to be ready for everything and you have to be able to adapt quick. I think the game of basketball is really about adaptation in real time, so I think that helps for the games a lot, because you can't just do what you asked for every time. There's going to be some randomness in the game, so I think it helped for sure.
quotes.social_post: Kasparas Jakučionis believes the game of basketball is really about adaptation in real time. He says you have to be ready for everything because there is always going to be some randomness in the game.

quotes.speaker: Kasparas Jakučionis
quotes.summary_phrase: Kasparas Jakučionis on his comfort level with pick-and-roll play
quotes.excerpt: I always feel the most comfortable playing pick-and-rolls
quotes.quote: The spacing and the movement is so important for us. Pick-and-rolls, yeah, that's all I've been doing my whole life except last year, because we didn't play much pick-and-rolls, but that's I think it's in my nature and I always feel the most comfortable playing pick-and-rolls. So, I'm kind of feeling good about that and just excited.
quotes.social_post: Kasparas Jakučionis says he feels most comfortable playing pick and rolls. He notes that while he did not run them much last year, it is in his nature and he is excited to get back to that style of play.

quotes.speaker: Kasparas Jakučionis
quotes.summary_phrase: Kasparas Jakučionis on the versatility of his teammate
quotes.excerpt: He can be a lob threat, he can shoot threes, he can pop
quotes.quote: I think he's a very adaptable person too. He can come in and I think in any system and it will work. He will make it work because he's so mobile. He can be a lob threat, he can shoot threes, he can pop, he can do everything. So I feel like it's only positive from him.
quotes.social_post: Kasparas Jakučionis is impressed by his teammate's versatility, calling him a lob threat who can also shoot threes and pop. He says his teammate can fit into any system because he is so mobile.

quotes.speaker: Kasparas Jakučionis
quotes.summary_phrase: Kasparas Jakučionis on the team's need to play games to improve
quotes.excerpt: I feel like you need to play games to figure it out
quotes.quote: Obviously I feel like you need to play games to figure it out. I think it's not going to be all perfect from the day one, so you got to keep consistent and keep playing games to figure it out. But so far, like I said, I feel like we're a very competitive group. I think we're working together. We look at the details a lot. We always want to do perfect during the practices so we can do good at the game. So just trust the process and keep doing what we're doing, I think we'll be fine.
quotes.social_post: Kasparas Jakučionis knows the Bucks will not be perfect from day one. He says the team needs to keep playing games to figure things out and just trust the process.
